product.title: Pyramids of Teotihuacan Private Tour

description.text: A private vehicle leaves Mexico City for Teotihuacan on a five-to-seven-hour outing reserved for one party. The guide covers the Pyramid of the Sun, Pyramid of the Moon, and the Avenue of the Dead, with snacks, bottled water, and site fees included. Stops include Teotihuacan, Pyramid of the Sun, Pyramid of the Moon. Hotel or vacation-rental pickup is arranged so the group avoids the public-bus transfer to the pyramids. Ideal for visitors basing in Mexico City who want a private Teotihuacan morning without joining a mixed coach.

highlights: Private Teotihuacan day from Mexico City
Hotel or vacation-rental pickup arranged on request

start.description: Pickup from a Mexico City hotel or listed vacation rental.

end.description: Return to your Mexico City meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
